description.value:
You were built for the trigger. Maybe a corp warframe walked free of its handlers; maybe a Flats veteran who learned that the only law down here is tempo. Either way, you are the crew's front rank - the body between the team and the muzzle flash.

Your engine is Adrenaline: you do not open a fight full. You bank it through the discipline of the trigger and spend it to escalate when the tempo turns your way. Operators are chrome-forward and cast nothing; every edge you have, you bought with steel, wire, and nerve.

The Adrenaline Engine

Adrenaline is earned by trigger discipline, not rage. You gain Adrenaline from these four triggers:

  • Cadence (+2): At the start of each of your turns in combat, gain 2 Adrenaline.
  • First contact (+ your Victories): On your first turn of each encounter, gain Adrenaline equal to your Victories.
  • Called shot (+2): When you drop an enemy, or land a Tier-1 result on a called or Aided target, gain 2 Adrenaline.
  • Fire discipline (+1): If you began your turn in cover and attacked from it, or took the Defend action last turn, gain 1 Adrenaline.

Cap by Hero Tier (T5 to T1): 8 / 11 / 14 / 18 / 22. Unspent Adrenaline is lost at the end of the encounter - you cannot bank it between fights. Signature abilities cost no Adrenaline; heroic abilities spend it. Adrenaline is class power and never bought or fed by nuyen or Body Integrity - chrome makes your abilities better, it never generates Adrenaline.
